mkdisk -size=3 -unit=M -path=/home/mariano/Discos/disco1.mia
fdisk -size=2 -unit=M -path=/home/mariano/Discos/disco1.mia -type=P -name=part1
mount -path=/home/mariano/Discos/disco1.mia -name=part1
mkfs -id=491A -type=full
login -user=root -pass=123 -id=491A
mkfile -path=/home/user/docs/a.txt -size=15 -r
rep -id=491A -path=/home/mariano/Reportes/mbr.jpg -name=mbr
rep -id=491A -path=/home/mariano/Reportes/sb.jpg -name=sb
rep -id=491A -path=/home/mariano/Reportes/bm_inode.txt -name=bm_inode
rep -id=491A -path=/home/mariano/Reportes/bm_block.txt -name=bm_block
rep -id=491A -path=/home/mariano/Reportes/file.txt -name=file -path_file_ls=/home/user/docs/a.txt
logout
